name: agentdock
description: AgentDock - AI Development Control Plane Engine and CLI Package

scripts.test:coverage: node -e "fs.mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && node --test --test-timeout=60000 --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=dot --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info packages/*/tests/*.test.ts scripts/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check:coverage: npm run --silent test:coverage && node scripts/warn-window.ts 2026-12-05 scripts/coverage-gate.ts coverage/lcov.info
